name: GitLab CI
description: Pipelines defined in .gitlab-ci.yml with built-in environments and approvals.

pricing.notes: GitLab.com free tier: 400 CI/CD compute minutes/month. Extra minutes are purchasable a la carte, or GitLab Premium ($29/user/mo) raises the included allowance to 10,000 minutes/month. Checked 2026-08-07.
